title: Ngoc Linh ginseng: Precious natural gift from Da Nang’s ancient forests
description: Grown beneath the primeval forests of Ngoc Linh Mountain at elevations of 1,500–2,000 metres, Ngoc Linh ginseng is prized as one of the world’s finest varieties, containing 52 saponin compounds.The central coastal city of Da Nang is expanding cultivation of this rare, high-value medicinal plant alongside deep-processing industries.
